prompts.title: Sunrise · Dark
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Generate a narrowly revised Remilo native full-screen alarm screenshot, one flat edge-to-edge portrait screen at 360 x 800 dp proportions, about 841 x 1870 px. No phone hardware, comparison board, outside headline, marketing composition or annotations. Crisp production Android typography, consistent measured spacing and genuine mobile density.
INPUT ROLES: First image is the approved R6 single native alarm COMPOSITION reference (Sky Light); translate it to Dark. Second image is the rejected generic alarm's exact privacy-safe CONTENT reference; its plain visual treatment is REJECTED, not a style reference. Third image is the approved named atmosphere DARK homepage, used ONLY for artwork/color tokens.
Preserve one shared native alarm layout in every atmosphere: integrated top mountain/lake/conifer illustration, small Remilo wordmark, roughly 200 dp opening below status bar; then opaque dark reading surface with16dp gutters/radius and calm generic information, and bottom fixed opaque urgent-action footer.
EXACT CONTENT: held status clock "10:00"; "Alarm ringing" with a NEUTRAL light-gray bell glyph; generic title "Reminder" in28sp; "Alarm time" neutral-gray label and "10:00 AM" prominent32sp. This screen is before first unlock. There is NO category icon/badge, NO Water plants, no Event/Due, notes, list, private task title or unlock prompt. The theme is global, never selected from reminder content. Leave calm flexible space after alarm time, do not invent data to fill it.
BOTTOM ACTIONS: one full-width FILLED theme-primary "Stop" with matching dark onPrimary label; one full-width OUTLINED theme-primary "Snooze · 10 min" underneath, both64dp high (about150px on841px-wide canvas),16dp radius,12dp gap. Readable neutral helper "Stop leaves the reminder unfinished." and Android gesture inset. No Done/checkmark/success, no app navbar/FAB, no back/search/edit/overflow/close controls. Do not shrink buttons, extend the canvas, or redesign geometry between themes. Structural icons remain neutral; only actual Stop/Snooze use primary.
ALL READING SURFACES ARE OPAQUE; text never sits over complex scenery. Use accepted landscape style, not generic gradients/waves or an independent redesign. Final artwork abstraction is deferred. This is a held review clock, not an automatic period rule.
ATMOSPHERE AND PALETTE: Match approved Sunrise Dark: glowing warm amber/orange sunrise sun over layered muted mountains and lake, conifers, dark charcoal/warm-black opaque body. Stop fill soft amber/apricot with near-black label; Snooze amber outline/label. Warm art does not change passive gray glyphs. This is sunrise, not mauve sunset, moon or night stars.
